Welcome to this episode where Aastha Khurana helps you uncover a side of investing most people ignore — your own behaviour. Through a simple but powerful framework, this video challenges what you think you know about your risk-taking ability and shows why that assumption might be wrong. If you’ve ever felt confident in bull markets but uncomfortable during corrections, this might completely change how you approach investing decisions.
